text: Figure 3.3: RTE Contract Phase With the generated ’Component API’ (application header file) the Software Compo- nent developer can provide the Software Component’s source code without being con- cerned as to whether the communication will later be local or using some network(s). It has to be considered that the AUTOSAR software-component development process is iterative and that the AUTOSAR software-component description might be changed during the development of the AUTOSAR software-component. This requires the ap- plication header file to be regenerated to reflect the changes done in the software- component description.
